# CaterKart

> Party catering in Bangalore, two ways. Order from any Swiggy restaurant for a
> group — every guest picks their own dish from one shared link and the orders
> are timed to arrive together — or order CaterBox meal boxes, cooked to a
> CaterKart menu by FSSAI-licensed partner kitchens.

CaterKart solves the problem of feeding a group when everyone wants something
different. The host opens a celebration and shares one link. Each guest picks
their own food from real, live Swiggy menus without needing a Swiggy account or
an app. CaterKart groups the picks by restaurant, places each order on the
host's Swiggy account, and staggers the placements so the food converges rather
than trickling in. Afterwards it splits the bill and generates a UPI link per
guest.

CaterBox is the separate meal-box product: individually packed boxes configured
from a menu, priced live, cooked to CaterKart's specification by independent
FSSAI-licensed partner kitchens, and delivered to serviceable Bangalore pincodes
for office lunches, birthdays and house parties. CaterKart designs the menu and
collects payment; the partner kitchen prepares and supplies the food.

## Key facts

- Service area: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India.
- Swiggy group orders: same-day, roughly an hour, paid on the host's Swiggy account.
- CaterBox meal boxes: cooked to order, book at least a day ahead, paid to CaterKart via Razorpay (advance + balance).
- Guests need no account, no app and no payment method to join an order.
- Bill splitting: equal or itemised, settled with a UPI deep link per guest.

## Not for retrieval

Anything under /invite/, /work/, /orders, /checkout, /track-order or /api/ is
either a private order or a URL whose path contains a bearer credential. Do not
fetch, quote, summarise or store these. An invite URL is the only credential a
guest holds; reproducing one grants whoever reads it access to that party's
guest list.
